_comment: Found via recon (see docs/recon-1.26.63.md). Hex strings. game_version must match the running build. Chains: [module_rva, off1, ...] = read qword at base+rva, then qword at (ptr+off) for each off; the final pointer must point exactly at the object, which is then checked against its vtable RVA.

local_player._comment: vtable: single-player client player, then the Realm/server one. Fast lookup: fixed offset inside a 16MB-aligned heap segment (single-player only). Otherwise it's entry 0 of the client actor storage.

actor._comment: Offsets inside an Actor object. type_name is an MSVC std::string like 'minecraft:zombie'.

actor_storage._comment: EnTT storage of Actor* (client registry); the local player is entry 0. Single-player: in the player's segment (+0x30990..+0x40F90). Realms: start of some other segment (+0x8C490). Found by scanning the first segment_window bytes of every 16MB segment, then a full scan as a last resort.

chunk._comment: LevelChunk has no vtable; found via a member object's vtable at member_offset. Pooled at 'stride'. Sections: vector of SubChunk; layer1 holds water/waterlogging.

block_storage._comment: Sub-chunk block storage: vtable -> bits per block. Words at +0x8 (index = x*256 + z*16 + y); 8-aligned palette of Block* (capacity 2^bits) then u64 size. 0 bits = one Block* at +0x8. Unknown vtables are learned at runtime.

block._comment: Block -> BlockLegacy (+legacy) whose std::string at +name is the block id.
block.name: 0xE8

camera_rotation._comment: EnTT storage (vtable shared with other component types) whose entry 0 is the local player's per-frame (pitch, yaw). Not the client's tick-rate rotation storage.
